title: A Rig Veda selection says that at first the non-existent was not, and the existent was not
summary: This Rig Veda excerpt says that at first neither the non-existent nor the existent was.
body: The Internet Archive copy of this Rig Veda selection says the non-existent was not and the existent was not at that time. The hymn asks about the origin of being and leaves the gods' place uncertain. It is one hymn, not the whole Veda, and the page is a teaching excerpt. The wording on the page includes: "whole process is shrouded in mystery. Where do the gods fit in this creation scheme? The non-existent was not; the existent was not at that time. The atmosphere was not nor the heavens which are beyond. What was concealed? Where? In whose protection? Was it water? An unfathomable abyss? There was neither death nor immortality then. There was not distinction of day". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
